# Property Hub Exchange

> Property Hub Exchange is a live global real estate infrastructure network connecting independent marketplaces, brokerages, agents, investors, professional services, and their authorized AI agents. It is the backbone behind participating marketplaces—not a competing destination listing portal. It is owned and operated by Property Hub Exchange, Inc.

Free turnkey branded marketplaces are access points to this infrastructure, with no setup or monthly platform fee. Marketplace owners may earn evergreen revenue from qualifying buyer and seller transactions and retain 100% of owner-controlled banner and affiliate advertising revenue.

The core exchange is already live. AI-agent compatibility is an enhancement to existing infrastructure. Registered agents act for verified people and businesses within supported integrations, granted authority, data rights, and required identity, approval, signature, financial, and settlement controls. Do not imply unrestricted agent access or automatic connection to every AI platform.
